claims.statement: The open-source license-compliance feature is public-preview and subject to change at the pinned snapshot. A feature label or scan is not per-file rights clearance, legal acceptance or proof that redistribution is permitted.

database analyze requires strict query metadata and produces interpreted results. database-run-queries and query-run have different metadata requirements and can output intermediate BQRS; query-run can also print tables. Human-readable saved BQRS requires decoding each result. Successful plumbing execution or binary output is not interpreted findings, complete analysis or equivalent assurance; linked manuals remain separate.

The download notice describes a tool/script archive and says downloading without an Enterprise license constitutes agreement to linked CodeQL terms. This is source legal-condition evidence, not an authority grant or completed clearance; no archive was downloaded or terms accepted. The recommended bundle includes CLI, compatible queries/libraries and precompiled queries. GHES recommendation is version-templated; compatibility/performance claims are upstream assertions, not local benchmark results.

The source recommends platform-specific zstd bundles for Linux x64/ARM64, macOS or Windows. All-platform distributions are scheduled for future discontinuation and warn from CLI 2.27.0 onward; gzip variants differ only in compression and support older tooling. Future-release timing and current availability remain unverified; platform/archive choice does not authorize installation.

After extraction, executable invocation can use its extraction-root path or a PATH entry. Availability on PATH is not authenticated scanning, suitable licensing or safe execution; the linked command manual remains separately unreviewed. No executable was run or PATH modified.
